items.title: Iterates of the endpoints of the exchanged intervals produce symmetric intervals
items.author: Przemyslaw Berk; Frank Trujillo
items.work: Ergodic properties of infinite extension of symmetric interval exchange transformations
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 693-704: for a symmetric interval exchange transformation, an index alpha different from the special one and an exponent m below the connection time, the conjugate of the transformation at the m-th backward iterate of the left endpoint equals the m-th forward iterate of the left endpoint of the previous exchanged interval, and the interval spanned by these two points is symmetric. The proof (source lines 706-724) combines three identities that are not in the statement: the conjugacy identity for iterates, the description of the reflection of an endpoint as the endpoint of the next exchanged interval, and the bound by the connection time, which is what keeps every point involved away from the discontinuities so that the identities may be applied at all. The statement records the resulting formula and the symmetry conclusion only.
